generator: The distribution the synthetic dataset is drawn from
addObjective: Add an objective to the loss
subsetSize: The number of items to select
scalarization: How the objectives are combined into one loss
algorithm: The search algorithm that selects the subset
xFeature: The feature shown on the x axis
yFeature: The feature shown on the y axis
weight: The λ weight value of this objective
relationRandom: The value is drawn uniformly at random from the range
transform: Add a transform of the dataset's data
transformChoice: The transform applied to the representation it reads
representation: The representation the objective is evaluated on
nodeAdd: Add a transform of this representation
nodeRemove: Remove this representation and everything derived from it
chartOn: The representation of the dataset the chart shows
lossXAxis: The measure of progress along the x axis
